newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Smith Barney starts Argentine banks.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Smith Barney starts Argentine banks.

text.p: Smith Barney said analyst Jason Mollin initiated coverage of some Argentine Banks.
-- said started Banco Frances de la Plata SA with a "neutral, high risk" rating.
-- said Banco Frances' expanded branch network and expanded client base puts it in a better position to grow its marketshare, especially in the retail segment.
-- said Banco Frances would become the second largest private bank in Argentina after the completion of its recently announced merger with Banco Credito Argentino.
-- said initiated coverage of Banco del Sud SA with an "outperform, speculative" rating.
-- said views Bansud as a "turnaround" story with expected earnings growth of 20 percent in fiscal 1998 and 33 percent in fiscal 1999.
-- said initiated coverage of Banco de Galicia SA with an "outperform, high risk" rating.
-- said expects Banco de Galicia will be able to maintain its position as a leading bank in Argentina due to its solid management team and strong branch network.
